Scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和他的妈妈搬家了，after the mother has already been mentioned, use a pronoun-based possessive phrase instead of repeating the full name. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): `孟子和孟子妈妈`：`他们`，Both people were named in the immediately preceding clause, so a pronoun naturally refers back to them without repeating their names. [rule: none]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和他的妈妈，Use a pronoun for the possessive relationship when the character has just been mentioned; repeating the name in the same phrase is unnecessary. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

output.reason: All runs target the redundant repeated subject, but the teacher’s accepted fix is to omit it entirely, whereas the proposed replacements retain a subject.
